title: Split payment: gift card + card at checkout
description:
Context: Customers with a gift-card balance cannot combine it with a card payment at checkout; they ask support to burn the card in a separate transaction. The checkout payment-list flow is the existing integration point.
Scope: This story allows paying with one gift card plus one card in a single order. Out of scope: multiple gift cards, native apps.
epic_context: Payment Platform Expansion — Alternative Payment Methods
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: Note from discovery: 18% of gift-card holders abandoned checkout last quarter with a partial-balance card in cart (analytics funnel report); support logged 210 such contacts this year.

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: Priority rationale: gift-card sales grew 40% YoY; retention team flagged combined-payment as the top driver of gift-card complaints in Q3.

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: Success criterion: cut the partial-balance checkout abandonment (18% baseline) by half within two quarters of release.
